result.instructions: Tools for Juro, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the contract templates in our account and show the questions for the NDA one."; "Which contracts were updated since Monday, and which of them are fully signed?"; "Create a draft contract from the NDA template for Acme Ltd with the counterparty name filled in.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Juro data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run juro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run juro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run juro_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. juro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: juro_health
tools.title: Check Juro API access
tools.description: Check that the Juro API key works and the account can reach the API. Returns the health message from Juro. Juro API: GET /v3/health.

tools.name: juro_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the contract templates in the account (id, name, status, dates). Use the id as template_id when creating a contract. Juro API: GET /v3/templates.

tools.name: juro_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template with its questions (uid, title, isRequired, signingSideUids), fields and signing sides. Read the questions before creating a contract. Juro API: GET /v3/templates/{template_id}.

tools.name: juro_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: List contracts the API key can access, newest updates first when filtered by updated_since. Returns total and a page of contracts (id, name, dates, template, workspace). Juro API: GET /v3/contracts.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (UTC when no offset).

updated_before.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (UTC when no offset).

team_ids.description: Comma-separated workspace ids to filter by.

template_id.description: Only contracts made from this template id.

tools.name: juro_get_contract
tools.title: Get a contract
tools.description: Get one contract: status, questions and answers state, fields, signing sides with signing URLs, approval state and tables. Juro API: GET /v3/contracts/{contract_id}.

contract_id.description: The contract id (from juro_list_contracts or juro_create_contract).

tools.name: juro_create_contract
tools.title: Create a contract draft
tools.description: Create a DRAFT contract from a published template with the answers and fields you give. Nothing is sent to anyone: no signing link goes out. The template must be published in Juro. Juro API: POST /v3/contracts.

answers.description: Answers to template questions (uid and value).

uid.description: Question or field uid from the template.
Question or field uid from the template.

tools.name: juro_update_contract
tools.title: Update a contract
tools.description: Change a contract name or field values. On a signed contract only fields can change, and a field used in the document or its questions is refused. Juro API: PATCH /v3/contracts/{contract_id}.

fields.description: Smartfield values to set (uid and value).

uid.description: Question or field uid from the template.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Juro
prompts.description: What you can do with Juro here, with example requests to try.
